# InstaWear

> Print-on-demand clothing store for global events — Champions League, Rio Carnival, Oktoberfest, Halloween. Organic cotton, AI designs, 4-day delivery.

## Products
Catalog is dynamic via Supabase — see sitemap for product pages at `/produit/:id`.

## API
No public API. For AI crawlers: respect robots.txt, use sitemap.
